region.text: Madurai, Tiruchirapalli and parts of South Arcot, the Delhi province of Ma'bar

ledger.note: 1335: Jalaluddin Ahsan Khan proclaims the Madurai Sultanate. 'The sultanate was proclaimed in 1335 in Madurai, led by Jalaluddin Ahsan Khan'; 'Numismatic evidence points to 1335 CE as the founding year' (Firishta has 1340).

region.text: the Madurai country, fought over by Kumara Kampana

ledger.note: 1370: Vijayanagara attacks Madurai. 'Bowman states that the Madurai Sultanate was conquered and destroyed by Kumara Kampana and his forces in 1370 CE'; the Kumara Kampana page dates his power in the south 'by the early 1370s' and gives no end of the sultanate.

1378: Vijayanagara takes Madurai for good. 'Vijayanagara formally made Madurai to be its possession during Harihara II's rule in 1378 CE'; the last sultan Ala-ud-Din Sikandar Shah 'was killed in the battle of Madurai'.

region.text: Madurai, Tiruchirapalli and parts of South Arcot

ledger.note: 1378: the Madurai Sultanate ends. Infobox 'Disestablished: 1378'; 'until 1378 CE when the Vijayanagara Empire destroyed and conquered them'; the Bowman date for the destruction is 1370.

wars.name: Madurai-Hoysala war
wars.outcome: The sultanate captured and killed the Hoysala king Veera Ballala III in 1343 at the siege of Kannanur Koppam; no land changed hands on the page.

wars.name: Vijayanagara conquest of Madurai
wars.outcome: Kumara Kampana defeated the Sambuvarayas in 1363-64 and had his power in the south by the early 1370s; Madurai was destroyed in 1370 (Bowman) and formally Vijayanagara's in 1378.

certainty.note: The page names three places, not boundaries; every frontier is approximate.

notes:
No Cliopatria row (Cliopatria's Pandya Empire ends 1325 and nothing covers 1326-1378 in the south). Two pages: Madurai Sultanate (thin on territory) and Kumara Kampana (no year for the sultanate's end). The shape is three circles round the places the page names.
Disagreements: founding 1335 (numismatics and infobox) against Firishta's 1340; Jalaluddin Ahsan Khan's rule ends 1339 in the table, 1340 in the text; Madurai destroyed 1370 (Bowman) against 1378 (formal annexation, infobox); Tughlaq's Tamil expedition is dated 1337 on the page.
Not settled: the Tughlaq conquest of Ma'bar in 1323-1325 (not on the page; sa-04-a's pandya-empire carries the Pandya side to 1325); the Pandya remnant in the south after 1325; the Sambuvarayas of Kanchi (conquered 1363-64 by Kampana, not part of the sultanate); the sultanate's boundary with Vijayanagara before 1370; Ballala III's war 1343 left no land change.
Counterparts: tughlaq-dynasty and vijayanagara-empire (sa-04-b, sa-04-c); hoysala-kingdom (sa-03).
